_readme: This is the EXAMPLE config. It is safe to commit: no secrets, no personal paths.
# then set the absolute path to server.mjs on your machine, the key if your RAG uses one, and enabled: true.
mcp-hub.config.json and mcp-hub.config.local.json are gitignored and must never be committed.
The hub reads mcp-hub.config.local.json first if it exists, then mcp-hub.config.json.
